capabilities: Define custom project structures with container folders and content notes
Compile projects into a manuscript using step-based workflows with placeholders
Track per-node writing statuses that roll up to parent containers
Collect, review and resolve anchored comments and suggested edits from proofreaders
Run optional AI grammar checks that record findings as comments
disambiguation: Not limited to novels despite the name; it supports any user-defined structure, including screenplays with acts and sequences.
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; can be installed via BRAT. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer. Grammar checking is desktop only, and the plugin states it never sends data anywhere unless a check is run.
intentEvidence: Novelr is inspired by Longform and novelWriter.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to organize long-form projects like novels or screenplays into user-defined hierarchies and compile them into a single manuscript.
